name: synscore
description: Route-based synthesizability score derived from the number of non-purchasable starting materials in the best route

name: bb_coverage
description: Fraction of the best route starting materials that are purchasable

name: solved
description: One if a route of depth five or less was found with every starting material purchasable and zero otherwise

name: number_of_steps
description: Reactions in the shortest solved route and empty when no solved route was found

name: number_of_precursors
description: Starting materials in the best route found

name: number_of_precursors_in_stock
description: Starting materials in the best route that are purchasable
